recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中三顆反應性淋巴球：中間細胞核不規則、胞質淡藍含多個空泡且邊緣呈扇貝狀；右側為大型、胞質深嗜鹼並有胞質泡突（bleb）的細胞；左下為較小的漿細胞樣淋巴球。多形性的反應性淋巴球是傳染性單核球增多症的線索。
features: Large reactive lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm and heterogeneous appearance
Center cell: irregular, lobulated nucleus with pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm and scalloped margins
Right cell: large round nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm forming a cytoplasmic bleb
Lower left cell: smaller lymphocyte with more basophilic cytoplasm at the periphery
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic; one platelet present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large reactive lymphocytes with a spectrum of morphology. One cell has an irregular, lobulated nucleus with pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm and scalloped borders, another is a large cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a cytoplasmic bleb, and a third is a smaller lymphocyte with peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia. Red cells are unremarkable and blasts are not seen. The heterogeneous reactive lymphocytosis is consistent with infectious mononucleosis, supported clinically by a positive heterophile (monospot) test.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: Neoplastic lymphocytes are monotonous with uniform nuclei and clonal on flow cytometry, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size and cytoplasm.
Blasts have high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than abundant basophilic cytoplasm with condensed chromatin.

ddx.dx: CMV or acute HIV infection, toxoplasmosis
ddx.vs: These produce morphologically identical reactive lymphocytes and are separated only by serology or PCR (heterophile-negative).
Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and a folded nucleus with lacy chromatin, without deep peripheral basophilia.
